## Grain Photo vVERSION — Pure Blackout Viewfinder, Gallery Multi-Select & Minimalist Onboarding

- **Already have Grain installed (v0.7.1+):** Open Grain (or **MENU → SET UP → APP UPDATE**) to install **vVERSION** directly inside the app.
- **First-time install:** Download and install **Grain-vVERSION.apk** below.

### What's new in v0.7.3

#### 1. Pure Blackout Optical Viewfinder
- Tap the top-left **Viewfinder eyepiece** on the camera body to enter **Blackout Viewfinder**: the entire camera body, dials, rear LCD, and shutter ring turn **pure `#000000` black**, leaving **only the top-left optical viewfinder window** with the live preview.
- **Pure optical framing:** Tap inside the viewfinder window to meter and lock focus, press **Volume + / Volume −** to shoot, and tap anywhere on the black screen (or swipe Back) to return to the camera body.

#### 2. Also Included from v0.7.0 – v0.7.2
- **Gallery Multi-Select + Batch Delete & Save:** Select multiple frames together, toggle **All / None**, batch **Delete (N)** with 7-second **Undo**, or batch **Save (N)**.
- **Minimalist Darkroom Onboarding:** 4-step tactile hardware onboarding (replayable anytime via **MENU → SET UP → INTRO GUIDE**).
- **Xiaomi HyperOS / MIUI In-App Updater Fix:** Seamless `FileProvider` system installer handoff.
- **Shutter Speed & ISO Dial Fix, Bright Kodak (`BKD`), and Hardware Flash (`⚡`).**

Signed with the project's personal key (certificate SHA-256 `6e073ef6…`). `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies the APK download.
